title: SSM One document catalogue
status: Optimized target/reference, not deployment or a database seed
rules: Families are logical groups, not official numbers or required separate files
Requiredness is determined by accepted stage/customer/applicability contracts
Reuse software records; file export is a rendition
Blank templates/policies belong in Common; actual records use project context or Other work
Preserve separate confidential scopes and unique subtypes when grouping
Cataloguing is not a prerequisite to complete all families before shipping the current flow
